Weather × time-of-day × lap position

orbit / day / dry

Reference. Saturated deep-blue sky with a hard horizon (brief says hazy pale blue-grey). Autumn orange/yellow tree mix. Bare brown 'jigsaw' terrain beside the road, no marsh green. f67: tilted red and white panels at the verge. f83: hairpin has no stands, tyre wall or apron; dark patch plus a black floating diamond on the inside apex. f50: leafless stick tree in the foreground.

orbit / day / wet

Wet look reads (dark tarmac, reflections), sky still day-bright.

orbit / day / rain

Day rain stays daytime (merge of day-wet-lighting-b7b8 applied). Ground reflects trees and stands as a mirror, not just the tarmac.

orbit / day / overcast

Grey sky. Reads plausibly.

orbit / day / fog

Fog thickens the ground but the SKY stays saturated blue: weather response is incomplete. Also a full grid of cars is visible at f33 (see uncertain list).

orbit / day / storm

Storm at day: dark grey sky, rain streaks, wet mirror ground. Looks like day storm, not night.

orbit / dusk / dry

Dusk dry.

orbit / dusk / rain

Dusk rain: lamp pools visible, sky grey.

orbit / night / dry

Night: the lamp posts along the pit straight and back straight give warm pools. No distant floodlights or lit stands beyond the pit complex; Pudong cluster has lit windows. Sky pure black.

orbit / night / rain

Night rain: lamp reflections on road; the wet ground mirrors stands.

eye / day / dry

Driver-eye frames. f50 and f67 put blank grey tower slabs right at the road edge.

Ranked defects

HIGH ~20 scenery emitters are keyed by raw authored fraction, so they land +0.0895 of a lap (~485 m) after the feature they name. The hairpin dressing (grandstandEx 0.88-0.93 side -1, tyreWall 0.885-0.915, runoffApron(K(0.90)), marshalPost(K(0.90)), hedge/tree 0.90-0.95, fanTerraces [0.905]) lands at built 0.97-1.02, the start/pit straight. The real hairpin (R=13 m, built 0.8227) is bare in the f83 frames. The back-straight dressing (raw 0.72-0.88: stands, sails, lamps, pines, billboards, fences) lands at built 0.81-0.97, after the 1108 m straight (built 0.606-0.81), which reads empty in the f67 frames.
Where: shanghai.js (scenery):885-906, 988, 1026-1032 (hairpin set); 852-883, 358 (back straight); also 789-806, 808-817 mid-arena, 835-850, 979-985 guardrail/fence ranges.

Not captured / uncertain

  • Dawn not captured; wet/overcast/fog/storm at dusk and night not captured (trimmed to dry and rain for those times of day). Trackside and cinematic cameras skipped; eye frames cover day dry only.
  • Orbit cameras step around occluders, so exact prop positions are inferred from code plus frames, not from prop-level queries.
  • Fog and dusk frames show a full grid at f33 while dry frames show one car: race start state differs per batch group; not investigated.
  • Real-world dimensions (length, width, grades) were not re-verified against external sources in this run; brief figures are source claims.
  • Hairpin dark patch/black diamond, leafless tree, tilted panels, and paddy visibility are undiagnosed.
  • Filenames follow shanghai-<nn>-f<pct>-<cam>-<tod>-<weather>.jpg (tod before weather, as build-gallery parses). Frames are 960 px JPEG q80, not PNG.
